title: Sprinkles' First Race 🍦🏁 | MegaWheel Arena Story Ep. 1
description:
Everyone said she was too slow, too heavy... too sweet. One month before the MegaWheel Grand Race, Sprinkles the ice cream truck decides to race anyway: four weeks of training, a promise to her Grandpa, and a race day nobody will ever forget... because KRAGGOR is coming. 🦖

Who is the real champion? Watch till the end! 🏆
